title: Prototype recorder event envelope (v0.1, LOCKED)
description: M4 § Event envelope. The v0.1 envelope is LOCKED at M4: additive payload extensions are permitted, but adding fields to the envelope itself requires a schema bump (v0.2) with a migration shim. Per M4 § DR-002 / DR-052. Source-of-truth Rust struct: cf-replay/src/lib.rs::Event.

schema_version.description: Envelope schema id. MUST be 'prototype-recorder-event.v0.1' for M4 bundles.

run_id.description: The owning run's id; must equal run_manifest.json.run_id and the bundle directory basename.

tick.description: Sim tick at which the event fired. Monotonically non-decreasing within a run.

sim_time_ms.description: Sim-clock time in milliseconds at which the event fired.

category.description: Event category (one of the 38 taxonomy categories declared in system.category_baseline).

event_type.description: Event type within the category (e.g. 'weapon_fired' under category='combat').

payload.description: Per-(category, event_type) payload. Shape is governed by the schemas under schemas/event/.

parent_event_id.description: Optional cause-chain pointer to an earlier event_id in the same bundle. Forms the M10 cause-chain walk surface.

actor_id.description: Optional acting RecordId(u64). Use the stable record_id layer; never raw pointers / pooled MOIDs.

source_id.description: Optional source RecordId(u64) (e.g. weapon/equipment that produced the event).

team.description: Optional team affiliation tag of the acting entity.

pos.description: Optional 2D position [x, y] in world space.

bbox.description: Optional bounding box { min: [x, y], max: [x, y] }.

dropped_count.description: Outstanding recorder backpressure drops tagged onto this event. summary.json.event_counts.dropped_total >= sum of all dropped_count fields.

cosmetic.description: DR-052 cosmetic flag. When true, the event is excluded from determinism.sim_checksum and is preferentially dropped first under recorder backpressure.

asset_ref.description: Optional M4A asset-ledger reference for any AI-generated asset used by this event.
